title: Tables turn in University of Hyderabad students' union polls; left combine emerges victorious
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
verified_by: The Hindu bureau report, article fetched and fact-matched 2026-10-02
bullets_en: Left combine wins University of Hyderabad students' union polls for 2026-27.
SFI's Dilshada Raihan VP is the new president, winning by over 450 votes.
The alliance includes AISA, ASA, DSU, SFI and the Tribal Students' Forum.
Results were notified on October 1 after counting that ran past 3 a.m.
ABVP-SLVD, which swept all six posts last year, won only the sports secretary seat.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad University ke students' union election 2026-27 mein left combine jeet gayi.
SFI ki Dilshada Raihan VP nayi president rawi, 450 se ziyada votes se jeet.
Is alliance mein AISA, ASA, DSU, SFI aur Tribal Students' Forum shaamil hain.
Ginti raat 3 baje tak chali; natije 1 October ko notify kiye gaye.
Pichle saal chhe pad jeetne wali ABVP-SLVD ko is baar sirf sports secretary pad mila.
